title: Tempo: Memory allocation with excessive size value, Allocation of resources without limits or… (CVE-2026-82458)
description: CVE-2026-82458 is a high-severity vulnerability in the tempo package involving memory allocation with excessive size values and allocation of resources without limits or throttling. It affects multiple language bindings of Apache Thrift, including Go, OCaml, Erlang, JavaME, Rust, C++, Java, Kotlin, and D. The flaw allows uncontrolled resource consumption, potentially leading to denial of service. Fixed versions are available.
